模块规则","kind":"attack-module-configuration","scope":"shared-module","description":"敌方远程攻击共用的有限弹幕规则：一次攻击按具体装备发出弹体，最多4发；弹体沿路径碰撞，遇墙停止，同一发不重复击中同一目标。实际发数、射程与出手节奏由敌方装备决定，模块本身不会给玩家增加齐射技能。","version":2,"iconGuid":"98a61f90-d8f0-596d-bfbd-ffa9d3a99e6e","families":["module-tuning"],"mechanism":{"kind":"attack-module-configuration","parameters":{"configuration":{"targeting":{"selection":"nearest-hostile-to-owner","lock":"target-point-at-launch","lineOfSight":"required-at-windup"},"execution":{"timeline":"windup-flight-recovery-cooldown","repeat":"once-per-target-per-projectile"},"collision":{"shape":"sphere-sweep","targetAuthority":"unit-hit-region-graph","movingTargetPolicy":"relative-ccd","environmentContact":"stop-projectile"},"capacity":{}},"moduleId":"bounded-projectile-volley","sourceDomain":{"effectiveUsage":"native-module","modules":[],"boards":[],"ownerChain":["bounded-projectile-volley"],"purePresentation":false,"ordinaryAvailability":"execution-module-only","moduleEvidence":"assets/packs/abilities/attack-modules/bounded-projectile-volley.pack.ts","ownerId":"bounded-projectile-volley"}}},"strength":[{"field":"configuration.capacity.maximumProjectilesPerActivation","label":"单次攻击投射物数量上限","formula":{"kind":"constant","value":4,"unit":"枚","levels":{"min":1,"max":1,"kind":"integer"}}},{"field":"configuration.capacity.maximumActiveProjectilesPerOwner","label":"单装备在场弹体容量上限","formula":{"kind":"constant","value":4,"unit":"枚","levels":{"min":1,"max":1,"kind":"integer"}}},{"field":"configuration.capacity.maximumActiveProjectilesGlobal","label":"全局在场投射物数量上限","formula":{"kind":"constant","value":256,"unit":"枚","levels":{"min":1,"max":1,"kind":"integer"}}},{"field":"configuration.capacity.maximumPersistentZonesGlobal","label":"全局持续区域数量上限","formula":{"kind":"constant","value":64,"unit":"处","levels":{"min":1,"max":1,"kind":"integer"}}}],"relations":{"defaultWeight":0.05,"familyRules":[],"targetOverrides":[]},"provenance":{"sourcePaths":["assets/packs/content/shared/effects/attack-modules/module.bounded-projectile-volley/effect.pack.ts","assets/packs/abilities/attack-modules/bounded-projectile-volley.pack.ts"],"legacyNodeIds":[]},"designNotes":["原生模块继续负责固定步执行；此处只迁移作者参数，不建立效果到模块的反向读取。","所有数值保留作者常量；L1是公式单样本坐标，不新增成长轴。","当前真实消费者包括敌方箭矢、羽刃、根须种子和炉火投射等装备；同模块只共享连续碰撞、停止和容量规则，不把这些攻击的伤害、冷却或外观混为一套。","单次最多4发、单装备执行器最多4发在场，全局弹体256、持续区域64。具体装备可只发1发；上限不得解释成固定四倍伤害。","球形扫掠按目标相对运动检查接触；命中白盒来自UnitStore，图中的箭线不是新的碰撞或随机来源。图签三条散射箭表示齐射方式，不声明实际发数为3。","模块公式只有L1常量，不是可拾取或升级技能。攻击效果通过图中的“执行模块”结构边引用本规则，再从模块载体追溯配置效果；它不授予玩家弹幕，也不因共用执行器提高其他敌方攻击的取得概率。默认0.05亲和保持，结构边不参与概率。"],"placement":{"contentPackId":"shared","categoryPath":["effects","attack-modules"],"scope":"shared"}}}
